'''''Storm Fire''''' was a vessel in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that was shot down in the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="Third-Party Interest">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Third-Party Interest|Hoth}}</ref> in [[3665 BBY]].<ref name="Gnost">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>
